scope: Retained seeded MONAI 1.6.0 CPU oracles compared with native FP32 MLX on Metal

results.skipped_scope: Optional released-checkpoint AMOS CUDA comparisons; checkpoint and upstream captures were not supplied

corrections: InstanceNorm: two-pass statistics with compensated FP32 sums, rounded variance sum, fused bias coefficient and unfused output affine
Transpose convolution: contract input channels before adding spatial-kernel contributions in source z/y/x order
GELU: retain the ARM CPU erf and exponential approximation and its explicit FMA sequence
Biased projections: retain the small class-GEMM reduction and full/edge-tile bias placement for the pinned 48-feature graph

independent_diagnostics.pointwise_projection_profile: Verified with independent random weights and inputs at 2048, 4096, 8192, 12288 and 32768 spatial rows; the admitted encoder requires at least 8192 rows
independent_diagnostics.class_projection_profile: Probed across 1 to 117 class rows, including both sides of the 12-row CPU GEMM dispatch boundary

limits: Seeded numerical parity does not establish pretrained-checkpoint accuracy or clinical performance
The projection accumulation profile was measured against the ARM Accelerate build of PyTorch 2.14.1
No CUDA reference case or end-to-end production performance benchmark was run
